stances.summary: Opposes billionaire control of AI, backs democratic governance
stances.quote: The American people — not a handful of billionaires — should decide the future of AI.

stances.summary: Warns AI development is realizing predicted societal harms
stances.quote: Everything we feared about AI is coming true.

stances.summary: Opposes AI mass surveillance by Flock camera network
stances.quote:
The AI surveillance company Flock has installed nearly 100,000 cameras across America to track your every movement. 
 
Going to the doctor? Flock knows.
 
Dropping your kid off at school? Flock is tracking you.
 
Flock is always watching.
 
STOP AI MASS SURVEILLANCE. STOP FLOCK.

stances.summary: Calls for immediate pause on AI development to prevent catastrophic risks
stances.quote: Almost every day, there is a new story about companies losing control of AI, with potentially cataclysmic results. It is not too late to avoid disaster. In the interest of humanity, AI leaders must PAUSE AI development. Stop building machines that humans cannot control.

stances.summary: Demands AI leaders pause development over safety concerns
stances.quote:
We recently learned of the loss of human control and the creation of potentially dangerous viruses from AI.

AI leaders pledged to pause development if they could no longer safely control it.

Mr. Altman, Mr. Amodei, Mr. Zuckerberg: Keep your word.

PAUSE AI DEVELOPMENT.

stances.summary: Praises communities restricting AI data centers, opposes billionaire control of AI
stances.quote:
Over 500 communities across America now have laws on the books that ban or restrict the rapid expansion of AI data centers.

The American people are standing up to the Big Tech oligarchs and making it clear: billionaires don't get to decide the future of AI. We do.

stances.summary: Criticizes Big Tech for harmful effects on youth mental health
stances.quote:
Teens that spend over 4 hours a day on screens are more depressed, more isolated and more anti-social.
 
Is this really the world we want for our children? 
 
I talked to parents about how we can stop Big Tech from rewiring our kids' brains.

stances.summary: Opposes Big Tech oligarch influence in elections via AI super PACs
stances.quote:
AI super PACs, funded by Big Tech oligarchs, are spending tens of millions to buy our elections.

Will my colleagues in Congress have the guts to stand up to them and ensure this transformational technology works for all of us, and not just make a few billionaires even richer?

stances.summary: Supports union efforts to protect port workers from AI automation
stances.quote:
I had the opportunity to meet with Bobby Olvera Jr., President of the West Coast Longshore Union, to discuss how AI and robotics are replacing workers at our ports.

Thank you President Olvera for standing strong to protect the jobs of American workers against AI and robots.

stances.summary: Warns AI poses existential risk, demands serious policy response
stances.quote:
The film Don't Look Up told the story of scientists warning the world about a comet heading toward Earth.

People ignored the warnings. The planet was destroyed.

That was fiction.

Artificial intelligence is not. We cannot afford to ignore the warnings. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1

stances.summary: Opposes AI robots replacing teachers in schools
stances.quote:
Big Tech companies are now pushing humanoid robots to replace teachers.
 
Do we really want AI robots teaching our children?
 
Maybe I'm old-fashioned, but I believe our children deserve caring, well-trained teachers—not robots programmed to replace them.

stances.summary: Advocates Medicare for All expansion to dental, vision, hearing
stances.quote:
When we talk about Medicare for All, we’re not just talking about covering every man, woman and child.

We’re talking about expanding Medicare to cover dental, vision and hearing — something supported by 92% of Americans.

Healthcare is a human right. Let’s make it happen.

stances.summary: Criticizes wealth-based life expectancy gap as unacceptable
stances.quote:
Life expectancy in Loudoun County, VA, the highest-earning county in the US: 84 years.

Life expectancy in McDowell County, WV, one of the lowest-earning counties in the US: 65 years.

Poverty, economic stress and a lack of health care are a DEATH SENTENCE.

Not acceptable.

stances.summary: Calls for Medicare for All, frames healthcare as human right
stances.quote:
For years, we've been told Medicare for All is "too radical."
 
Really? A new YouGov poll shows 64% of Americans support a Medicare for All, single-payer system.

The American people agree: Healthcare is a human right.

Let's get it done.

stances.summary: Advocates Medicare for All as cost-effective, life-saving alternative
stances.quote:
A new study confirms that Medicare for All would save 114,000 lives every year and reduce overall healthcare spending by more than $1 trillion annually.
 
Do not tell me we cannot afford Medicare for All.
 
What we cannot afford is a broken healthcare system based on greed.

stances.summary: Calls healthcare system broken, demands Medicare for All passage
stances.quote:
The American healthcare system is broken.

Insurance and drug companies make billions, while healthcare is unaffordable.

Healthcare is a human right, not a privilege.

Democrats must pass Medicare for All.

stances.summary: Criticizes hospital system for low wages, demands fair contract negotiations
stances.quote:
It's unacceptable that Mass General Brigham refuses to meet its nurses at the bargaining table to negotiate a fair contract.

MGB made $2.4 billion last year and pays its CEO over $8 million/year.

MGB must treat nurses and home care workers with the respect they deserve.

stances.summary: Condemns broken healthcare system, advocates Medicare for All
stances.quote:
This is what a broken healthcare system looks like:

More uninsured patients are showing up in emergency rooms. 
More people are unable to pay their hospital bills. 
More Americans are delaying surgeries they cannot afford.

Healthcare is a human right. We need Medicare for All.

stances.summary: Opposes Trump drug cost plan, defends Medicare subsidy program

Trump said he would cut drug costs by 1,500%. He lied.
 
Instead, his administration is ending a Medicare subsidy program, which will raise prescription costs for about 25 million seniors.
 
Outrageous! We must LOWER prescription drug costs, not raise them.
